items.html: The fifth correction is the Will of Wills (Re'uta deRe'in), which is revealed in the prayer of the lower ones; it is the forehead of Arich Anpin, and in it is hidden the Yesod of Atik. Now the aspect of the upper Netzah and Hod, which are the two ears and the two membranes, from which [the light] descends to the mouth of the membrum — this is the Yesod of Atik hidden in the forehead. Therefore even in this forehead there is the power of the judgments that are drawn into it from the aforementioned Netzah and Hod.
